name: solute carrier family 34 member 2

function.text: SLC34A2 encodes sodium-dependent phosphate transport protein 2B (Na(+)-dependent phosphate cotransporter 2B)/Pi cotransporter 2B). Annotated molecular activities include sodium:phosphate symporter activity and phosphate ion binding. It participates in phosphate ion transport and response to estrogen.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to pulmonary alveolar microlithiasis (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Acute Myeloid Leukemia; Colorectal Adenocarcinoma; Lung Adenocarcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
